response.sql: WITH counts AS (SELECT o.timespan, COUNT(DISTINCT o.orderspivot) AS order_count FROM orders AS o JOIN riskandmargin AS r ON r.ordervault = o.recordvault WHERE o.timespan IS NOT NULL GROUP BY o.timespan) SELECT timespan, order_count, order_count::numeric / SUM(order_count) OVER () AS share, order_count::numeric / SUM(order_count) OVER () - 1::numeric / COUNT(*) OVER () AS difference_from_average_share FROM counts ORDER BY timespan;

assumptions.assumption: Only non-NULL time-in-force values with at least one matched risk/margin record appear; the average is across those values.

alternatives.interpretation: Include all four documented time-in-force values, including those with no matched records.
alternatives.sql: WITH tif(timespan) AS (VALUES ('IOC'), ('GTC'), ('GTD'), ('FOK')), matched AS (SELECT DISTINCT o.orderspivot, o.timespan FROM orders AS o JOIN riskandmargin AS r ON r.ordervault = o.recordvault), counts AS (SELECT tif.timespan, COUNT(m.orderspivot) AS order_count FROM tif LEFT JOIN matched AS m ON m.timespan = tif.timespan GROUP BY tif.timespan) SELECT timespan, order_count, order_count::numeric / NULLIF(SUM(order_count) OVER (), 0) AS share, order_count::numeric / NULLIF(SUM(order_count) OVER (), 0) - 1::numeric / COUNT(*) OVER () AS difference_from_average_share FROM counts ORDER BY timespan;
